title: Attention-Weighted Value Projection for KV-Cache Compression
abstract: arXiv:2604.11501v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Rank reduction discards dimensions; quantization keeps them at lower precision. Comparing the two requires a choice of what compression should preserve. For attention values, we study reconstruction   of the attention output rather than reconstruction of the values alone. With fixed attention weights, the optimal orthogonal rank-$r$ projection uses the leading eigenvectors of   $V^\top\alpha^\top\alpha V$, and its error is exactly the discarded eigenvalue sum. We extend this objective to calibration datasets and grouped query attention, and describe rank allocation under   an additive local error budget. We also examine the limits of using local error to predict downstream loss. Historical weight-perturbation experiments favor coefficient rounding over the value   projections tested, but do not establish a comparison at equal cache storage. The resulting distinction is practical: the projection objective has an exact solution,

translated_title: 面向KV缓存压缩的注意力加权值投影
translated_abstract: 秩约减会丢弃维度；量化则以更低精度保留维度。比较这两种方法需要先确定压缩应该保留什么。针对注意力值，我们研究的是注意力输出的重建，而不仅仅是值本身的重建。在固定注意力权重的条件下，最优的正交秩-r投影使用 V^⊤α^⊤αV 的主特征向量，其误差恰好等于被丢弃的特征值之和。我们将这一目标扩展到校准数据集和分组查询注意力（GQA）场景，并描述了在加性局部误差预算下的秩分配策略。我们还检验了利用局部误差预测下游损失的局限性。历史上的权重扰动实验更倾向于系数舍入而非所测试的值投影，但并未在相同缓存存储条件下建立公平比较。由此产生的区别具有实用性：投影目标存在精确解，
tldr: 提出了一种面向KV缓存压缩的注意力加权值投影方法，通过以重建注意力输出（而非仅重建值本身）为目标，利用 V^⊤α^⊤αV 的主特征向量得到具有精确最优解的秩约减方案，其误差恰好等于被丢弃特征值之和，并将该目标扩展至校准数据集与分组查询注意力场景。
en_tdlr: Proposes an attention-weighted value projection for KV-cache compression that optimally reconstructs the attention output rather than the values alone, providing an exact solution via the leading eigenvectors of V^⊤α^⊤αV whose error equals exactly the discarded eigenvalue sum, and extends this objective to calibration datasets and grouped query attention.
